candidate: H70 W0-conditioned block atlas with shared local basis
causal_question: Can a globally shared full-rank 32-coordinate basis, routed by exact procedural paired-W0 blocks and a 16-dimensional live layer latent, express every dominant and weak joint MLP trajectory direction under one percent persistent state?
forbidden: CE training or evaluation as a promotion criterion
stored trajectory PCs, empirical ambient bases, dense shadows, per-row codes, or per-block codes
width, block-size, latent, activation, optimizer, objective, seed, layer, or horizon sweeps

inputs.residual_gauge: joint complete-neuron c_fc rows plus transposed c_proj rows, exact step-zero subtraction, uncentered displacement PCA

required_reports: FP32 masters, gradients, optimizer moments, and nuisance-code bytes
refresh wall time, total runtime, and peak CUDA allocation

fit.objective: uniform mean over layers and all top-16 PCs of independently normalized paired detector-plus-write block reconstruction error
fit.offline_pc_codes: one fitted 16-vector per measured layer and PC is an image-capacity nuisance coordinate and is not deployed state

controls.equal_state_linear: replace the GELU difference with C z while retaining and charging every candidate tensor
controls.w0_blind: replace exact paired W0 blocks with deterministic seed-bound Gaussian pseudo-initialization of identical shape
controls.fixed_random_local_basis: freeze D_u and D_v at their seed-bound initialization while optimizing the router and nuisance codes
controls.unpaired: fit separate detector and write nuisance codes as an optimistic diagnostic

metrics: D_u and D_v numerical ranks and singular-value condition
state bytes, refresh arithmetic, runtime, peak CUDA memory, and all hashes
promotion: Only a complete representation pass authorizes frozen-decoder chronological late-state and disjoint-stream A/B audits with fresh nuisance codes. It does not authorize CE, attention, or scale-up.
rejection: Any required gate failure closes block-32/shared-width-2048 H70 without a sweep and requires new theory before another transform.
